about_the_game:
Welcome to Price of Theft, an atmospheric first-person psychological horror game where reality and madness intertwine within the walls of an old estate.

You explore a house where strange rituals were once performed. Every room holds its own secrets, and around every corner lies something best left undisturbed.

Explore your surroundings, collect notes and objects, and solve logic and sound puzzles. Immerse yourself in the story left behind by the house's inhabitants and reconstruct the chain of events that led to the horror that still lingers within these walls.

Price of Theft isn't just terrifying—it makes you question the boundaries between fear, guilt, and salvation. It's important not only to survive, but also to understand why you ended up here.

Features

Atmospheric first-person horror

Explore a vast estate with numerous secrets and locations

Notes, diaries, and artifacts that reveal the story

Interactive soundscapes that influence perception

Screamers and frightening scenes integrated into the narrative

Logical and audio puzzles

Non-linear exploration and multiple endings

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10750H или AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 MB available space

short_description: A first-person psychological horror game about fear, guilt, and obsession. Explore a cursed estate, solve puzzles, find notes, and confront what lurks in the darkness. Atmosphere, suspense, and jump scares will make your heart beat faster.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian
